event_records.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is publicly visible with two million views and screenshots that look genuine.

founder_of_tidepool.name: Founder of Tidepool
founder_of_tidepool.persona_brief:
You are Founder of Tidepool.
The founder knows that Tidepool's head of support privately confirmed that some critical reviews were taken down. The founder has received email inquiries from two journalists about the viral thread. The founder must decide whether to post a public response.

resolution.question: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Tidepool posted a public response to the viral thread before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
